test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : ORW :: RUZ : %
solution:
The logic followed here is:

# : ORW :: RUZ : %

Option 1) # = UYD % = KNS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df00d56e4205471ccd184e6805025b5e32d206ef1d8ac5e73aeabbec8f24b33.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f516d895f086a1170465b31904b573ec68f72378bd95378e13e5233a1b951391.png] 

Here, not follow same logic.

Option 2) # = VYD % = LNS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/410139d7accc80e405c817b9c6b933645d3d15d11f54ff22a2e989911facf7b9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e49e1d61e2bf72abb7c5b5554ecf34d53ec8c513710ba159ea1963f5f6cfc940.png] 

Here, not follow same logic.

**Option 3) # = VYD % = KNS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b1e9d56474cb0d4c81f9bd369aa9f6ac662b0825f07e18aca3b819f88deaae9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d8b460b39fbeffce668541bddb3428ce9095430f638462068713ed3409bc78d.png] 

**Here, follow the same logic.**

Option 4) # = VYD % = KNK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3eaaa697b9cda235b9f7ff88c8605be0a2dd385696092a4b8989e3758a6e932.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3492136ba35af994c0c1abc66f280bf48951297f961040a2a64a0257cf953828.png] 

Here, not follow same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
